item.text: The model is formulated as a sparse linear program: positive/negative coefficient and residual parts make the check-loss objective linear while leaving coefficients unrestricted. I’m running the supplied tests now.

Implemented `fit_wealth_quantile` in [analysis.py](/Users/john/Desktop/Software_Testing_Term_Project/runs/nls_incarceration_quantreg__all__neutral__n3__codex-gpt-5.6-terra__r1__20261104T135431Z/workspace/analysis.py) using SciPy’s linear-programming solver to minimize quantile check loss exactly.

Results confirm the incarceration penalty is much larger at the 90th percentile ($-128,500) than at the median ($-6,000). All tests pass: `6 passed`.
